why: The Harness web-only and no-source doors (2026-09-26): "Get the Mac app" and "Connect a source folder", each the page's one way forward. They were filled `pill`s, a shape the system keeps for a state or a count, and read as a second primary shape beside every other screen's. Both navigate, so they are `<Link>` through `cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "primary", size: "sm" }), …)`; `control-class.ts` does not replace standard buttons.
